label: И
description: Additive sentences that train how Russian chains ideas with 'and'.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two linked actions. 1. 'И' joins two verbs without changing the subject. 2. 'Читаю' and 'пишу' both stay in first person singular. 3. This is a clean entry point for additive logic.
Strategic focus: Parallel actions. 1. 'Ты' forces both verbs into second person singular. 2. 'Идешь' and 'слушаешь' are easy to compare. 3. The sentence trains smooth coordination.
Strategic focus: One subject, two objects. 1. 'Берет' is a direct action verb. 2. 'Книгу и сумку' shows that one verb can govern a list. 3. This is useful for everyday carrying language.
Strategic focus: Shopping list logic. 1. 'Мы покупаем' is a very common present-tense frame. 2. 'Хлеб и молоко' are simple, reusable nouns. 3. The line is practical and easy to remember.
Strategic focus: Joined subjects. 1. 'И' can join two nouns into a compound subject. 2. 'Дома' closes the sentence naturally. 3. This teaches that 'and' works on subject level too.
Strategic focus: Plural predicate agreement. 1. Two nouns make the predicate plural. 2. 'Открыты' is the matching short-form adjective. 3. The sentence is a good grammar test for agreement.
Strategic focus: Visual object list. 1. 'Вижу' stays in first person singular. 2. 'Дом и сад' gives two concrete objects at once. 3. This is simple but dense enough to train focus.

Strategic focus: Coordinated adverbs. 1. 'По-русски и по-английски' shows two modes of speech. 2. The sentence is useful for language identity and bilingual contexts. 3. It also reinforces the adverbial pattern with 'по-'.
Strategic focus: Joined nouns with location. 1. Two nouns are treated as a pair. 2. 'На столе' gives the shared location. 3. This is an everyday visual sentence that learners can picture instantly.
Strategic focus: Contrast within one subject. 1. 'Они' drives both verbs. 2. 'Работают и отдыхают' is a very natural life pattern. 3. The sentence is good for practicing balance and rhythm.
